svg.title: One LMA fund amount, two published financial reports
svg.desc: An original Final Vestige Studios source-reconciliation graphic. The Lakefront Management Authority's 2025 standalone audit and Flood Protection Authority–East's consolidated 2025 audit each print $106,377 for the same LMA OLD Real Estate Fund royalties, leases and permits category. These are two presentations of one fund-level amount, not two payments. The FPA consolidated total of $169,656 also includes $63,279 in the Orleans Levee District General Fund. Lease-level transactions remain unverified.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; created: 2026-11-18; copyright: © 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Original explanatory diagram. Rights: studio-owned vector art; source records retain their own rights. Source A: Louisiana Legislative Auditor, Lakefront Management Authority FY2025 report, printed pp. 16 and 53, https://app.lla.state.la.us/PublicReports.nsf/0/C1CFBE668F38D1E086258D46005AFA4C/$FILE/000091EA.pdf Source B: Louisiana Legislative Auditor, Southeast Louisiana Flood Protection Authority-East FY2025 report, printed p. 16, https://app.lla.state.la.us/PublicReports.nsf/0/7A7589E9550859E586258D380070A30B/$FILE/0000906da.pdf Limitations: not a Bohemia-specific ledger, bank record, mineral-leasing statement or private-claimant payment history. No AI-generated historical imagery. Suggested caption: Two audits, one agency account. The same LMA OLD Real Estate Fund $106,377 appears in both FY2025 reports and must not be counted twice.
